classification: preregistered single-variant stock diversification follow-up to R326; no TopN grid and no risk-rule changes
question: R326 的黄金候选仅因前五股票贡献 75.60% 超过 75% 失败，同时黄金贡献 74.59% 接近上限。把 A/B 每个袖的持仓上限从固定 10 只改为固定 20 只、其余规则完全不变，能否在保留 R325 收益/回撤/年度稳定性的同时通过股票与黄金集中度门槛？

unchanged: R312 A/B 60d inverse-vol risk parity with A bounds [0.2,0.8]
15% total volatility target with gross exposure [0.2,1.0]
R325 60d inverse-vol between equity composite and gold ETF

performance_gates.D1_data: both gold ETF series cover >=95% of aligned dates with no duplicate, null or nonpositive close
performance_gates.G5_bootstrap: 20-day block bootstrap 1000 paths: positive rate >=80%, return P5 >= -12%
performance_gates.G9_incremental: versus frozen R312: Sharpe +0.05 or MDD +3pp; annual >= R312 annual -1pp
performance_gates.G10_no_leverage: all equity and gold asset weights >=0 and sum <=1

concentration_gates.C7_loss: largest stock loss <=20% of stock gross profit
concentration_gates.C9_gold_weight: mean target gold weight <=55% and maximum <=75%
concentration_gates.C10_etf_liquidity: coverage >=95%; median daily amount >=100m CNY; minimum 20-day average >=50m CNY
concentration_gates.C12_no_leverage: monthly equity + gold weights nonnegative and sum <=1.0

selection_rule: All performance and concentration gates pass -> candidate_for_paper_trading_review. Any failure -> selected=null and record negative knowledge. No other TopN values, weights, windows, ETF choices or thresholds may be tested after seeing results.
known_limitations: R327 is a post-R326 diversification response and therefore has additional multiple-testing risk.
The gold ETF tailwind remains sample-period dependent.
Attribution remains an approximate contribution-share diagnostic.
R40 local data, current factor snapshots and canonical data drift remain unresolved.
